audit.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Get-Command Get-ExchangeServer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Add-PSSnapin Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn -ErrorAction Stop }; if (-not (Get-Command Get-ExchangeServer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Exchange Management Shell cmdlets are not available' }; $bad = @(Get-ReceiveConnector -ErrorAction Stop | Get-ADPermission -User 'NT AUTHORITY\ANONYMOUS LOGON' -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { -not $_.Deny -and (($_.ExtendedRights | Out-String) -match 'ms-Exch-SMTP-Accept-Any-Recipient') }); $bad.Count
